topic: Asking for an OTC Cold Remedy

script.title: A COLD AND A PLAN
script.title_quote: I have medicine, but I won't take it
script.story_hook: A sick student finds a daytime cold plan that works.
script.intro_zh: 一位鼻塞的大學生,請藥師幫忙選不會想睡的感冒藥。
script.welcome_en: Hi there! Today: choosing a cold remedy.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來學怎麼挑感冒藥。
script.outro: Sixty lines later, you can plan a cold day now.
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完了,感冒天怎麼用藥你都會了。
script.practice_intro_en: Now your turn — say every line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你,和我一起唸每句話。
script.char_a_description: a college-age young man with curly blond hair and freckles, wearing an orange hoodie with the hood up, gray sweatpants and running shoes, tall and thin build, holding a tissue
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman with straight silver-gray hair pulled into a low bun, wearing a navy blouse under a white pharmacist coat, dark trousers and low heels, petite build with reading glasses

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I caught a cold — anything strong?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ kɑt ə kold ˈɛniˌθɪŋ stɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你好,我感冒了——有什麼藥效強的嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry! How long have you felt this way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju fɛlt ðɪs weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 真可惜!這樣幾天了?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Since Friday — sore throat, runny nose.
dialogue.zh: 從週五開始,喉嚨痛、流鼻水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any fever or body aches?
dialogue.zh: 有發燒或身體痠痛嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No fever, just a pounding head.
dialogue.zh: 沒發燒,只是頭很痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Can you swallow pills?
dialogue.zh: 了解。你吞得下藥錠嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but um, I need to stay awake.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ʌm aɪ nid tə steɪ əˈweɪk/
dialogue.zh: 可以,可是呃,我得保持清醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You drive or work with machines?
dialogue.zh: 你要開車或用機器嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I drive to campus every day.
dialogue.zh: 我每天開車去學校。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then daytime pills, non-drowsy.
dialogue.zh: 那就選白天吃、不會想睡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does non-drowsy mean, exactly?
dialogue.zh: 確切說,不會想睡是什麼意思?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It won't make you sleepy, like night syrups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt woʊnt meɪk ju ˈslɪpi laɪk naɪt ˈsərəps/
dialogue.zh: 它不會像夜間糖漿那樣讓你瞌睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. My throat really hurts at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt maɪ θroʊt ˈrɪli hərts æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我喉嚨夜裡特別痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try night capsules — they help you sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ naɪt ˈkæpsjʊlz ðeɪ hɛlp ju slip/
dialogue.zh: 試試夜間膠囊,幫你入睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Day non-drowsy, night sleepy — got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /deɪ ˈnɑn ˈdraʊzi naɪt ˈslɪpi ɡɑt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 白天不瞌睡,晚上好睡,懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Anything else you take?
dialogue.zh: 對。你還有吃別的藥嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a thyroid pill, every morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ˈθraɪd ˌaɪˈroʊd pɪl ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 只有甲狀腺藥,每天早上吃一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good you told me — we'll check that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ju toʊld mi wil tʃɛk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 幸好你說了,我們來檢查交互作用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that common? I didn't think of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈkɑmən aɪ dɪdnt θɪŋk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很常見嗎?我都沒想過這回事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes cold meds clash with others.
dialogue.zh: 有時候感冒藥會跟別的藥衝突。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa. Okay, I trust your pick.
dialogue.zh: 哇。好吧,我信你選的藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. This daytime box has no alcohol.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ðɪs ˈdeɪˌtaɪm bɑks hæz ˈnɑ ˈælkəhɔl/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。這盒白天吃的成分不含酒精。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect for driving. What about my headache?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpərfɪkt fər ˈdraɪvɪŋ wʌt əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈhɛdeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 開車剛好。那我的頭痛呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tablets cover headache and aches.
dialogue.zh: 裡面藥錠可以退燒止痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many tablets a day?
dialogue.zh: 一天吃幾錠?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, up to three times a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː ʌp tə θriː taɪmz ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一次兩錠,一天最多三次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With meals or between?
dialogue.zh: 要飯後吃,還是空腹?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With food — easier on the stomach.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð fud ˈiz iər ɑn ðə ˈstʌmək/
dialogue.zh: 配飯吃,對胃比較溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Um, can I take your supplements?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm kæn aɪ teɪk jɔr ˈsɑːpləmənts/
dialogue.zh: 好。呃,我可以買你們的補充品嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vitamin C and zinc — sure, over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvaɪtəmɪn si ænd zɪŋk ʃʊr ˈoʊvər ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 維生素C和鋅,都有,就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they actually help a cold?
dialogue.zh: 這些真的對感冒有幫助嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe a shorter cold — harmless, cheap.
dialogue.zh: 也許感冒短一點,無害又便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll grab some. For lozenges, what's good?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡræb səm fər ləˈzɛndʒɪz wʌts ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那我拿一些。喉糖哪種有效?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honey-lemon ones — numbing and tasty.
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜檸檬味,喉嚨比較不痛,味道也不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold! One more question… the price?
dialogue.zh: 買了!最後一問……多少錢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Daytime box, nineteen ninety-nine.
dialogue.zh: 白天盒,一百九十九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, and night capsules extra?
dialogue.zh: 嗯,夜間膠囊要加錢嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight — or the combo saves you five.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ɔr ðə ˈkɑmˌboʊ seɪvz ju faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 八塊,或買組合包省五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Combo, please. My wallet says thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmˌboʊ pliz maɪ ˈwɑlɪt sɛz θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 給我組合包。我錢包會感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Now, a tiny problem…
dialogue.zh: 哈!不過,有個小問題……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. What is it now?
dialogue.zh: 噢,不。這次又是什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The night capsules are sold out.
dialogue.zh: 夜間膠囊賣完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seriously? Then what do I take at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪriəsli ðɛn wʌt du aɪ teɪk æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 真的假的?那我晚上吃什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cherry syrup works — it's stronger.
dialogue.zh: 櫻桃糖漿有效,而且藥效更強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Syrup? Ugh, it tastes like cough medicine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪrəp ʌɡ ɪt teɪsts laɪk kɔf ˈmɛdəsən/
dialogue.zh: 糖漿?呃,吃起來跟止咳藥一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is cough medicine — mix it with juice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz kɔf ˈmɛdəsən mɪks ɪt wɪð dʒus/
dialogue.zh: 它就是止咳糖漿——可以混果汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, you win. Does it cause drowsy feelings?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ju wɪn dʌz ɪt kɔz ˈdraʊzi ˈfilɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 好吧,你贏了。會不會讓人想睡?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only at night — that's the plan, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli æt naɪt ðæts ðə plæn raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只會發生在夜間——計畫本來就是夜間用,對吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Yes, it is. And refills on lozenges?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jɛs ɪt ɪt ænd ˈriˌfɪlz ɑn ˈloʊzɛndʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 哈!沒錯。那喉糖可以補充嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're candy-legal — buy ten boxes.
dialogue.zh: 它就像糖果,想買幾盒都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two boxes, then. Where do I pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː ˈbɑksəz ðɛn wɛr du aɪ peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就兩盒。要在哪裡結帳?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Front register — right behind you.
dialogue.zh: 收銀台就在前面,您身後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. So, forty dollars total?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝,總共四十塊?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty-six — the combo discount applied.
dialogue.zh: 三十六,組合折扣自動扣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even better. Card or cash?
dialogue.zh: 更好了。刷卡還是付現?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either works — tap here.
dialogue.zh: 哪種都行,在這裡輕碰一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. You saved my weekend.
dialogue.zh: 完成了,你救了我的週末。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest, fluids, and salt water gargles.
dialogue.zh: 多休息、多喝水,再用溫鹽水漱口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have medicine, but I won't take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ˈmɛdəsən bʌt aɪ woʊnt teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 藥我是拿到了,可我才不吃呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Get well — see you next week!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɡɛt wɛl si ju nɛkst wik/
dialogue.zh: 哈!快點好起來,下週再見!

"I have medicine, but I won't take it!" — every sick student's joke, said in real English. In this 60-line A2 listening animation, a congested student asks a pharmacist for a cold plan that keeps him awake for his drive to campus: daytime non-drowsy pills, night capsules, checking his thyroid medicine for clashes, lozenges, a sold-out surprise, and a combo deal that saves five dollars. Listen line by line, then repeat every sentence out loud in the shadowing chapter. Polite, funny, and packed with real pharmacy-counter English. No memorizing — just listen often.
